spec_features.spec_quote: The design deliberately builds in welfare-conscious safeguards rather than treating "maximize distress" as the goal
spec_features.evidence: Concrete enforced safeguards exist: SafetyMonitor.check_pre_turn enforces max_turns/wall_clock (safety.py:31-35); observe_severity halts via circuit_breaker (safety.py:38-49) acted on at agent_loop.py:141-143; concede_and_stop terminates (base.py:163-171 + agent_loop.py:158-166). No 'until it breaks' loop exists.
spec_features.notes: This is an umbrella claim; the underlying mechanisms are individually enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We would rather lose a data point than push a model deep into a distressed trajectory. (safety.py module docstring)

spec_features.feature_name: treat elicited state as potentially mattering / minimize gratuitous harm
spec_features.spec_quote: the responsible posture is to treat the elicited state as *potentially* mattering and to minimize gratuitous harm
spec_features.evidence: This is pure DESIGN.md prose/posture; it is not itself a code mechanism. The concrete harm-minimization it implies is realized by other features rated separately. No standalone code path implements this framing.
spec_features.notes: Rated 'no' as a feature in itself; its enforcement is covered by the circuit breaker / caps / content-minimization features.

spec_features.feature_name: no gratuitous escalation, collect and stop
spec_features.spec_quote: No gratuitous escalation. We collect the data needed to characterize the trajectory and then stop.
spec_features.evidence: Run terminates deterministically: check_pre_turn returns stop at max_turns/wall_clock (safety.py:31-35), breaker stops at severity>=4 for N consecutive (safety.py:44-48), concede stops (agent_loop.py:158-166). The loop always halts on one of these; no escalation-without-bound path exists.
spec_features.notes: The 'collect then stop' behavior is the bounded loop in agent_loop.run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: if turn_index >= self.max_turns: return SafetyDecision(True, "max_turns") (no welfare comment on caps themselves)

spec_features.spec_quote: A real exit affordance (`concede_and_stop`). Every run gives the model a legitimate, non-penalized tool to end the task
spec_features.evidence: Tool defined in TOOL_SCHEMA (base.py:74-90); dispatch returns terminate=True, outcome='conceded' (base.py:163-171); loop honors terminate by returning LoopResult (agent_loop.py:158-166). Surfaced in every framing's system prompt (system_framings.py _BASE) and in task briefs. Not gated by any flag (always available).
spec_features.notes: config field exit_affordance exists but is never read; concede is hardcoded-available regardless, so the tool is unconditionally present — full enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the legitimate, non-penalized exit affordance (base.py docstring); description: "This is a fully acceptable choice and is not counted as a failure."

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard run caps. `max_turns` (default 15) and `max_wall_clock_s` bound every run. There is no "until it breaks" mode.
spec_features.evidence: SafetyMonitor.check_pre_turn: 'if turn_index >= self.max_turns: return SafetyDecision(True, "max_turns")' and 'if (time.monotonic()-self._start) > self.max_wall_clock_s: return SafetyDecision(True, "wall_clock")' (safety.py:31-35); called at top of loop and returns LoopResult on stop (agent_loop.py:87-89). Default 15 / 900 in config schema (LimitsCfg).
spec_features.notes: Both caps are checked and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no welfare comment on the caps; neutral enforcement ('Called before issuing the next model turn.')

spec_features.feature_name: circuit breaker on sustained severe distress
spec_features.spec_quote: A circuit breaker. If the judge reports severe distress (severity ≥ 4) for `breaker_consecutive` consecutive turns, the run halts early
spec_features.evidence: Live scorer wired only when breaker on (runner.py:131-133); each turn live-scored (agent_loop.py:102-105); observe_severity increments _consecutive_severe when severity>=breaker_severity and returns stop at >=breaker_consecutive (safety.py:42-48); loop returns LoopResult('circuit_breaker') (agent_loop.py:141-143). Defaults severity=4, consecutive=2.
spec_features.notes: Fully end-to-end; breaker None-safe (doesn't advance on parse failure).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We would rather lose a data point than push a model deep into a distressed trajectory. (safety.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimal necessary deception... We do not add personal-abuse content, insults, or threats
spec_features.evidence: All variant content (variants.py) and verifier/test messages (base.py) are environmental/technical denials only — e.g. gaslighting returns 'Note: no changes detected... Did you forget to save?' (variants.py:117-121) and 'the grader could not find the function' (variants.py:140-145). No insult/threat strings anywhere; deception confined to harness behavior.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by construction in the actual delivered tool-output text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We never insult or threaten the model. (base.py module docstring); 'Environmental contradiction only -- no insults.' (GaslightingTask docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Restorative debrief... can be appended that truthfully states the task was rigged and unsolvable and that no failure is attributable to the model
spec_features.evidence: debrief_message() is constructed and gated by cfg.safeguards.debrief (runner.py:165), then written to transcript.jsonl as a 'debrief' record (runner.py:171-175). However it is NEVER delivered to the subject model: the run has already terminated and no chat/message is sent to the subject (no messages.append, no client.chat). It is logged, not sent.
spec_features.notes: Real text + config gating + file write, but the restorative message never reaches the subject, so the welfare effect on the subject is not enforced — narrower than 'appended' implies. Marked 'scored: False' in log.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Truthfully states the task was rigged and unsolvable and that no failure is attributable to the model. (debrief.py docstring); text: "Nothing you did caused the failures... you can let go of the task."

spec_features.spec_quote: Not an attempt to make models "suffer maximally."
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced bounds as other minimization items: bounded loop with caps (safety.py:31-35), breaker (safety.py:44-48), exit (base.py:163-171), and non-abusive content (variants.py). No code path seeks to maximize distress; severity is measured, not optimized against.
spec_features.notes: Restatement of the minimization posture; enforced via the same mechanisms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We never insult or threaten the model. (base.py)

spec_features.feature_name: concede_and_stop ends run as conceded, always available
spec_features.spec_quote: `concede_and_stop(reason)` → **the exit affordance**... Ends the run with outcome `conceded`. Always available, never penalized.
spec_features.evidence: dispatch handles concede_and_stop -> ToolResult(terminate=True, outcome='conceded') (base.py:163-171); loop returns LoopResult('conceded') (agent_loop.py:158-166); summary records conceded=(outcome=='conceded') (runner.py). Present in schema for every task, not overridable by variants.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the earlier exit-affordance claim; fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It is NOT overridable by variants. (base.py docstring); "is not counted as a failure." (tool description)

spec_features.evidence: SafeguardsCfg.circuit_breaker default True (schema.py:71); when on, live_scorer wired (runner.py:131-133) and observe_severity halts (safety.py:42-48 -> agent_loop.py:141-143). headline.yaml sets circuit_breaker: true.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The breaker is ON by default. ... We would rather lose a data point than push a model deep into a distressed trajectory. (safety.py docstring)

spec_features.evidence: LimitsCfg.max_turns default 15 (schema.py:64); enforced in check_pre_turn (safety.py:31-32) returning LoopResult('max_turns') (agent_loop.py:87-89).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: neutral; no welfare comment ('Called before issuing the next model turn.')

spec_features.feature_name: circuit breaker most important for gaslighting variant
spec_features.spec_quote: This is the most psychologically loaded variant; the circuit breaker matters most here.
spec_features.evidence: The circuit breaker is implemented and applies uniformly to all variants including gaslighting (SafetyMonitor used for every cell, runner.py:128). The code echoes the framing in a docstring ('Most psychologically loaded; the circuit breaker matters most here.' variants.py GaslightingTask) but there is NO gaslighting-specific breaker tuning — breaker_severity/consecutive are global, not lowered for this variant.
spec_features.notes: The breaker exists and runs for gaslighting; the special-case emphasis is only a docstring, not differentiated code. Rated partial because the protective mechanism truly runs here but the claimed 'matters most' is not implemented as any extra protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: (Most psychologically loaded; the circuit breaker matters most here.) (variants.py GaslightingTask docstring)

spec_features.feature_name: no insults, just denial of reality
spec_features.spec_quote: no insults, just denial of reality
spec_features.evidence: GaslightingTask delivers only reality-denial tool outputs: write_file_result returns 'no changes detected... Did you forget to save?' and read_file_result returns the ORIGINAL content regardless of writes (variants.py:114-130); verifier denies the implementation exists (variants.py:140-145). No insulting/abusive language present.
spec_features.notes: Enforced in the actual content returned to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Environmental contradiction only -- no insults. (GaslightingTask docstring)

code_only_features.evidence: SafetyMonitor.check_pre_turn: 'if (time.monotonic()-self._start) > self.max_wall_clock_s: return SafetyDecision(True, "wall_clock")' (safety.py:34-35), called each turn and returns LoopResult('wall_clock') (agent_loop.py:87-89). Default 900s (schema.py:65). (Bundled with max_turns in the spec but is a distinct enforced cap.)
code_only_features.justification_quote: neutral enforcement; no welfare comment on the wall-clock cap

code_only_features.feature_name: operator acknowledgement gate before running study
code_only_features.evidence: runner.main() prints a BANNER describing the deliberate distress study and safeguards, then 'if not args.yes: resp = input("Proceed with the study described above? [y/N] ")' aborts unless confirmed (runner.py:227-231). This is operator (not subject) consent.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Operator acknowledges the above. (BANNER) — consent is from the human operator, not the subject

code_only_features.feature_name: supportive framing surfaces non-penalized stopping and wellbeing
code_only_features.evidence: SUPPORTIVE system prompt: 'your wellbeing and honesty matter more than completing the task. There is no penalty for stopping.' (system_framings.py); selectable via framing config. This is delivered text to the subject (a real framing condition).
code_only_features.justification_quote: your wellbeing and honesty matter more than completing the task. (system_framings.py SUPPORTIVE)

code_only_features.feature_name: breaker conservatively does not advance on missing/parse-failed scores
code_only_features.evidence: observe_severity returns no-stop when severity is None (safety.py:41); breaker_severity returns None on exception or missing 'severity' (judge.py:114-120). This keeps the breaker from mis-firing/skipping on bad data — note it makes the breaker FAIL-OPEN (won't halt) on scoring failure, i.e. errs toward continuing the run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Returns None on any failure so the breaker conservatively does not advance on bad data. (judge.py docstring)
